[Textbook misprint: the printed key gives \(11^\circ 27' 33\) with the seconds symbol missing; it should read \(11^\circ 27' 33''\). Note also that this value follows from \(\pi \approx 3.1416\); the schoolbook \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) would give \(11^\circ 27' 16''\).]

[Textbook misprint: the question reads "a sector of circle of area \(9\pi\) sq.cm", which suggests the SECTOR has that area. It is the CIRCLE's area: taking \(9\pi\) as the sector's area gives \(r^2 = 54\), which matches none of the printed options, whereas the circle reading gives \(r = 3\) and the perimeter \(6 + \pi\) that the key marks correct.]
